biotools.summary: SuBMIT is a toolkit designed to generate coarse-grained structure-based model (CG-SBM) input files for biomolecular simulations, enabling the study of protein folding, conformational transitions, and RNA-protein dynamics using packages like GROMACS and OpenMM.
biotools.name: SuBMIT: Coarse-Grained SBM Toolkit
